verdict.rationale: Google Cloud publishes an official pricing calculator (google-cloud-docs-14) plus free tier/credit details (google-cloud-docs-12,13,30,31) and per-service pricing pages are implied by the broader docs ecosystem; billing/budget docs (google-cloud-docs-9,26) further support cost estimation before committing. Missing for 10: explicit citation of individual per-service pricing pages (e.g., Compute Engine pricing page) rather than just the calculator and free-tier pages.
